evidence: The official 2011 report lists Dangjin units 1-8 as bituminous coal; the official 2016 report lists the expanded Dangjin fleet as bituminous coal.

The official report identifies Donghae units 1-2 as domestic/imported anthracite coal. The source site name included 'bio' during this period, but these 200 MW units are the coal units rather than the separate 30 MW biomass facility.
This is the renamed source label for the same 200 MW Donghae anthracite units.
The official report states that Honam converted from oil to coal in 1985 and lists its operating fuel as bituminous coal.
The official report lists six Ulsan steam units totaling 1,800 MW as oil-fired; source capacities identify units 1-6 as those steam units.
The official report identifies Ulsan combined-cycle generation as LNG; source capacities and unit sequence identify units 7-14 as combined-cycle units.
The official report lists Ilsan combined heat and power fuel as LNG.
